name: meetup-subscription-extension
description: The pingers_meetup_subscription leaf-node extension of a Meetup member: type 0xF0A2 (private use), extension_data = the member's 16-byte subscription id, encoded as an MLS Extension (RFC 9420 section 7.2, variable-length size prefix). It follows the pingers_grant_key extension in the leaf's extension list.
